quote_1: one of our own agents wrote candidate bugs, a second model filtered the ones it judged too easy
quote_2: the evaluated agent agreed with external graders 6.4 points less often on its own successful patches than on matched patches from peers
justification: ⟦T1⟧ is a two-model pipeline for creating eval items (one agent authors candidates, a second filters out the easy ones), whereas ⟦T2⟧ is a measurement of self-recognition/self-grading bias when an agent grades blinded pools of its own vs. peers' outputs; these are distinct mechanisms with no specific common core beyond generic evaluation.
